commands.title: Open File
commands.description: Open a file in the workspace's Neovim, starting it if needed, optionally at a line and column. An absolute path inside another git worktree of a workspace folder switches that folder to the worktree first and opens the file in its Neovim.

path.description: File to open; absolute, or relative to Neovim's working directory (the selected worktree of the first workspace folder that exists, else home).

line.description: 1-based line to put the cursor on; 0 or absent keeps the default position.

col.description: 1-based byte column on that line, clamped to the line length; 0 or absent puts the cursor at the line start. Ignored without line.

commands.title: Show in Quickfix
commands.description: Replace the workspace Neovim's quickfix list with the given locations, open the quickfix window and show the Code section. Returns once validated; nvim fills the list asynchronously in small batches. Takes 1 to 10000 items; only items in the first 1000 distinct files are kept, and the title then gets " (first 1000 files)". Unknown fields are rejected.

title.description: Quickfix list title, at most 512 chars without line breaks or NUL.

path.description: Absolute file path, at most 4096 bytes, without line breaks or NUL.

col.description: 1-based byte column up to 2147483647; 0 or absent for none.

text.description: Entry text, at most 512 chars, without NUL.

commands.title: Open Diffview
commands.description: Switch the workspace folder to the git worktree containing cwd when it is not the selected one, run DiffviewOpen -C<cwd> <rev> --untracked-scoped in that worktree's Neovim and show the Code section. The working tree, uncommitted and untracked files included, is compared against rev. When DiffviewOpen fails, for example because diffview is not installed, Neovim's error shows as the open failed badge.

cwd.description: Absolute path of the worktree root.

rev.description: Commit sha, 7 to 40 lowercase hex digits.

commands.title: Current Selection
commands.description: The current or last visual selection of the current root's Neovim: {path, startLine, endLine, text}. Fails with no selection when there is none.

commands.title: Reload Changed Files
commands.description: Run :checktime in every running Neovim of the workspace so buffers changed on disk under the given root reload; a no-op when none runs.

root.description: Absolute path whose files changed on disk.

commands.title: Stop Worktree Neovim
commands.description: Stop the workspace's Neovim whose root is the given path and keep it from starting there again until editor-nvim.release-root. Fails like restart while it has unsaved buffers, unless force is true. Only marks the root when no such Neovim exists.

root.description: Absolute root path of the Neovim, as listed in the workspace roots.

force.description: Stop even with unsaved buffers, discarding their changes.

commands.title: Unsaved Buffers
commands.description: List the modified buffers of every running Neovim of the workspace whose files are inside the given root, except files another Neovim holds inside its own root, as workspace-relative names; [] when there are none. Never stops or starts Neovim; fails with unsaved buffers: unknown when it does not respond.

root.description: Absolute root path of the Neovim, as listed in the workspace roots.

commands.title: Release Worktree Neovim
commands.description: End a stop-root: Neovim may start in the given root again, and starts now when it is still the workspace's current root.

root.description: Absolute root path passed to stop-root.

commands.title: Reveal File in Finder
commands.description: Reveal the file currently open in Neovim in Finder.

commands.title: Open Terminal Here
commands.description: Open a new terminal in the directory of the file open in Neovim, or in the first workspace folder.

commands.title: Import my nvim config
commands.description: Start an agent session in the Agents section that reads ~/.config/nvim and moves the user's own keymaps, options, autocmds and plugins into Clubmate's Neovim user layer, following the bundled nvim guide. Fails with open a project workspace first in the home workspace and with no ~/.config/nvim to import when that directory is missing.

commands.title: Restart Neovim
commands.description: Restart every running Neovim of the workspace (one per worktree). Fails while file buffers in any of them have unsaved changes, or while a running Neovim does not answer (unsaved buffers: unknown), unless force is true.

force.description: Restart even with unsaved buffers, discarding their changes.
